articles.title: Alphabet reveals $548M Qualcomm stake
articles.description: Google parent Alphabet disclosed a $548 million stake in Qualcomm, a long-time partner, which is trying to build a data centre business while its smartphone chip sales slump. The post Alphabet reveals $548M Qualcomm stake appeared first on Mobile World Live.
